profile.visual_desc: Bulky gray plate armor with rounded pauldrons. Features a yellow-orange leopard-print loincloth and a matching helmet plume. Large, heavy build.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Rugged male face with a sharp jawline and tanned skin. Spiky brown hair held by a thick blue headband. Determined, serious expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Massive conical gray jousting lance held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Standing upright in front-isometric view. Lance held vertically at the right side.
profile.step2_windup: Body shifts into a slight crouch. Lance lowers and pulls back to build momentum.
profile.step3_impact: Deep forward lunge toward the bottom-right. Sharp yellow-orange radial energy burst erupts at the lance tip.
profile.step4_finish: Maintains extended lunge pose. Lance remains pointed downward as the energy flash dissipates and the plume settles.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The radial energy burst in Frame 4 must align precisely with the point of the lance during its downward-right thrust.
